mapper.select: SELECT record_id FROM ha_conversation_history WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND turn_id = #{turnId} AND record_type = 'MESSAGE' ORDER BY message_sequence DESC

SELECT *, COALESCE(timeline_sequence, history_sequence) AS event_sequence FROM ha_conversation_history WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( record_type = 'EVENT' OR timeline_sequence IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY event_sequence
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ha_conversation_history ( owner_key, session_id, turn_id, record_type, record_id, payload_json, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{row.ownerKey}, #{row.sessionId}, #{row.turnId}, 'EVENT', #{row.recordId}, #{row.payloadJson}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt} )
